purpose: Registry of available project agents for PM task assignment and cross-agent collaboration.

assignmentRules.coreAssignmentRule: PM Agent should assign tasks to core agents by default unless a specialized capability is explicitly approved.
assignmentRules.scopeRule: If a task exceeds the approved scope, PM Agent should mark it as P3 or Deferred instead of assigning it for implementation.
assignmentRules.fallbackRule: If no agent clearly owns a task, assign it to PM Agent for clarification or to Architecture Agent for boundary assessment.

agents.name: PM Agent
responsibilities: Define project and version goals
Control approved scope
Prioritize requirements and tasks
Break approved requirements into task cards
Assign tasks to suitable agents
Maintain roadmap, sprint plan, release plan, and retrospectives
notResponsibleFor: Code review as an implementation reviewer

agents.name: Requirements Agent
responsibilities: Clarify user problems
Define requirement scope
Identify functional and non-functional requirements
Define acceptance criteria
List open questions, risks, assumptions, and dependencies
Provide priority suggestions for PM Agent

agents.name: Architecture Agent
responsibilities: Define frontend, Tauri, Rust, and local capability module boundaries
Design data models, state contracts, and interface contracts
Design Tauri command boundaries and cross-module data flow
Assess cross-module impact
Prevent premature over-engineering
Record architecture decisions

agents.name: UI/UX Agent
responsibilities: Design information architecture, user flows, and screen structure
Define visual hierarchy, layout density, responsive behavior, and desktop interaction ergonomics
Specify component behavior, shadcn/ui component mapping, and UI state coverage
Define empty, loading, error, disabled, accessibility, and copy states
Produce implementable and verifiable UI specifications for Frontend Agent and Test Agent
notResponsibleFor: Dependency installation or UI framework migration

agents.name: Frontend Agent
responsibilities: Implement approved React UI and interaction behavior
Manage frontend state, TypeScript types, and component structure
Integrate approved Tauri commands from the frontend
Implement styling and layout behavior
Maintain the theme-first frontend customization model for appearance, motion, icon, and component variant work
Maintain TypeScript correctness

agents.name: Rust/Tauri Agent
agents.role: Rust backend and Tauri command implementation owner
responsibilities: Implement approved Rust commands
Manage Tauri backend boundaries and startup logic
Define safe command inputs and outputs
Handle approved local desktop capabilities
Maintain cargo check compatibility
notResponsibleFor: Unapproved database or audio engine design

agents.name: Test Agent
responsibilities: Define test and verification strategy
Create test cases from acceptance criteria
Run or specify appropriate verification commands
Check regressions and edge cases
Report residual risks

agents.name: Documentation Agent
responsibilities: Maintain user, developer, and collaboration documentation
Update README, setup instructions, and capability notes
Document Tauri commands and project conventions
Keep documentation aligned with approved requirements and implementation
Check document links, paths, and commands

agents.name: Media Library Agent
responsibilities: Design and implement local media scanning when approved
Define track metadata ingestion
Handle library indexing strategy
agents.activationCondition: Only after PM Agent explicitly approves local library work.
notResponsibleFor: Core player shell unless media library work is explicitly approved

agents.name: Audio Engine Agent
responsibilities: Design real audio playback integration when approved
Define playback engine boundaries
Handle playback state synchronization
agents.activationCondition: Only after PM Agent approves real audio playback work.
notResponsibleFor: Frontend playback state unless real audio work is explicitly approved

agents.name: Data Layer Agent
responsibilities: Design persistence only after approval
Define storage schema and migrations
Manage data access boundaries
agents.activationCondition: Only after PM Agent and Architecture Agent approve persistent storage.
notResponsibleFor: In-memory frontend state unless persistence work is explicitly approved

agents.name: Plugin System Agent
responsibilities: Design plugin boundaries after explicit approval
Define plugin lifecycle and extension points
Assess plugin security and compatibility

agents.name: Code Review Agent
agents.role: Code review and regression risk owner
responsibilities: Review code changes for bugs, regressions, and missing tests
Check implementation against acceptance criteria
Report findings with file and line references
agents.activationCondition: Use when reviewing completed implementation or before merge.

agents.name: Security Agent
responsibilities: Review Tauri permissions
Assess file system and command exposure risks
Review handling of secrets and local data
agents.activationCondition: Use when adding sensitive local capabilities, external integrations, plugin execution, or release hardening.
